ADMIT-10.name: NOT_A_PASSWORD
ADMIT-10.description: Raised when what was offered at the door is not a password.

ADMIT-11.name: KEY_IN_THE_CLEAR
ADMIT-11.description: Raised when a key arrived from another machine over a connection its pin does not verify.

ADMIT-12.name: NOT_FOR_A_KEY
ADMIT-12.description: Raised when a key asked for something its scope does not reach.

ADMIT-13.name: NOT_OPEN
ADMIT-13.description: Raised when a claim names an invitation that is not open.

ADMIT-14.name: SHORT_CHOICE
ADMIT-14.description: Raised when the password chosen at a claim is shorter than the least this takes.

ADMIT-4.name: NOT_ADMITTED
ADMIT-4.description: Raised when a request carried no token, session or key this run admits.

ADMIT-5.name: ELSEWHERE
ADMIT-5.description: Raised when a request said it came from somewhere this server is not.

ADMIT-6.name: NOT_YOURS
ADMIT-6.description: Raised when an account asked for something that is not its to ask for.

ADMIT-7.name: UNCONFIRMED
ADMIT-7.description: Raised when the media server could not say whether an account is still one.

ADMIT-8.name: NOT_THE_PASSWORD
ADMIT-8.description: Raised when the password offered at the door was wrong, or none is set.

ADMIT-9.name: TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS
ADMIT-9.description: Raised when the door has been given too many wrong passwords lately.
